title: Brittany's Gluten-Free Boil Up
description: A hearty boil made with tender chunks of meat and a hint of jammy sweetness, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
2. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the bacon and cook until crispy, about 3 minutes.
4. Add the potatoes, onions, and carrots to the pot.
5. Sprinkle the boil seasoning over the top and stir to combine.
6. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
7. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
